title: Best Cloud Hosting 2026: 7 Hosts Compared on Price, Renewals and Who Manages the Server
excerpt: Seven cloud hosts compared on price, renewals and who manages the server, with the difference between cloud, VPS and shared hosting explained.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Best Cloud Hosting 2026: 7 Hosts Compared and Priced
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Best cloud hosting for 2026: 7 hosts compared on price, renewals, speed and who manages the server, each checked on its own site. Costs start at $4 a month.
meta.rl_answer: The best cloud hosting depends on how much of the server you want to manage. Cloudways is the best managed cloud for most sites, Kinsta is the best premium choice for WordPress, and DigitalOcean is the best unmanaged option for developers.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is cloud hosting? | Cloud hosting runs your site on a network of connected servers, not one machine. HostingAdvice says this improves reliability, uptime and flexibility compared with shared or VPS hosting.
How is cloud hosting different from shared hosting and VPS? | Shared hosting puts many sites on one server and they share its resources. A VPS gives you a fixed slice of one server. Cloud hosting gives you a slice on a network of servers, and many hosts let you add resources quickly.
How much does cloud hosting cost? | On this list a cloud plan runs from $4 a month (DigitalOcean) to $100 a month (SiteGround Cloud). Cloudways starts at $11 and Kinsta at $35. Hosting Ranked puts entry-level unmanaged cloud at about $4 to $6, managed cloud at $14 to $28 and premium managed cloud at $35 to $115.
Is cloud hosting good for WordPress? | Yes. Cloudways, Kinsta, ScalaHosting, SiteGround Cloud and Liquid Web all run WordPress well. Kinsta and SiteGround Cloud are built for it. DigitalOcean is fast, but it needs a page cache to be quick on WordPress.
Should I choose managed or unmanaged cloud hosting? | Choose managed if you do not want to patch servers, set up caching and watch security yourself. Choose unmanaged, such as a DigitalOcean Droplet, if you can run a server and want the lowest price.
Which cloud host is the fastest? | It depends on the test and the location. Webhostingcat measured a 77 ms time to first byte on Kinsta, and HostingGuider measured 157 ms on a Hostinger Cloud Startup server in Singapore. Test methods differ, so compare each number with its method.
Do I need AWS or Google Cloud directly? | Most sites do not. AWS and Google Cloud give you the most control, but the pricing is complex and you set everything up. Cloudways and Kinsta put a managed layer on top of them.
Does the renewal price matter for cloud hosting? | Yes for fixed-term plans. Hostinger Cloud Startup renews at 3.3 times its sale price and ScalaHosting Entry Cloud at 3.6 times. Cloudways and DigitalOcean charge the same price every month.
Does cloud hosting handle traffic spikes? | Some plans do. SiteGround Cloud offers autoscaling, and Cloudways has an autoscaling WordPress plan. On a fixed plan, a spike beyond your CPU and RAM still slows the site, so check the limits.
Where should the server be? | Close to your visitors. In HostingGuider's test a Singapore server answered in 157 ms from Singapore and 674 ms from Sydney.
Can I host more than one website on cloud hosting? | Often yes. SiteGround Cloud lists unlimited websites and Hostinger Cloud Startup lists unlimited sites. Kinsta limits sites by plan, so check the plan page.
Do I need technical skills to use cloud hosting? | Not on a managed plan. Cloudways, Kinsta and ScalaHosting give you a dashboard and handle the server. On DigitalOcean you need to be comfortable with servers.
How do I move my site to cloud hosting? | Back up the site, choose a server region near your visitors, copy the files and database, test on a temporary address, then switch the domain. Kinsta, Liquid Web and Hostinger list free migration, and SiteGround lists a free migrator plugin.
Is cloud hosting good for an online store? | It can be. Liquid Web handled 1,000 concurrent users with 0% errors in two tests, though one test saw a slow WooCommerce checkout. Kinsta and Cloudways are common choices for stores.
Which cloud host is best for agencies? | SiteGround Cloud lets you build your own plans and give clients their own roles. Kinsta and Cloudways are also popular with agencies.
Which cloud host has the best uptime? | In the tests we read, Kinsta recorded 100% on 20 monitored sites, ScalaHosting 100% in four tests and Cloudways 99.996% to 99.999% across five plans. Test windows are short, so treat uptime as a snapshot.
What is the best cloud hosting? | Cloudways is the best managed cloud for most sites, Kinsta is the best premium choice for WordPress, and DigitalOcean is the best unmanaged option for developers. It depends on how much of the server you want to manage.
Is cloud hosting better than VPS hosting? | They overlap. A VPS gives you a fixed slice of one server. Cloud hosting runs your site on a network of servers and is easier to grow. Hostinger describes its cloud plans as more resources than shared hosting but less control than a VPS.
What is the difference between cloud hosting and shared hosting? | Shared hosting puts many sites on one server for a fixed price. Cloud hosting gives your site its own slice of resources, and you can add more when traffic grows. Hostinger says cloud plans sit between shared hosting and a VPS.
What is unmanaged cloud hosting? | The host provides the server and you run it: updates, security, backups and caching. DigitalOcean Droplets start at $4 a month this way. Backups add 20% to 30%.
What is the best cloud hosting for small business? | Cloudways from the 2 GB size, Hostinger Cloud Startup for a low price on a long term, and Kinsta for a business WordPress site that needs managed speed and support. Check the renewal price before you buy.
What is the cheapest cloud hosting? | DigitalOcean Droplets start at $4 a month and you manage them yourself. Hostinger Cloud Startup is $7.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $25.99. Cloudways starts at $11 a month with no contract.
What is the best cloud hosting for WordPress? | Kinsta and Cloudways are managed WordPress options. Cloudways adds staging, Object Cache Pro on 4 GB servers and above, and a server firewall. Hostinger Cloud Startup includes WordPress staging and object cache.

meta.rl_takeaways:
We compared 7 cloud hosts. Cloudways, Kinsta and Hostinger were read on 20 November 2026 and the others between 15 and 18 November.
Cloud plans in this list run from $4 to $100 a month.
Cloudways, Kinsta and DigitalOcean charge the same price every month. Hostinger and ScalaHosting renew at 3.3 and 3.6 times their sale price.
Managed hosts look after the server. DigitalOcean leaves that to you.
